_schema.doc: Pinned phase-gate values. Each entry references a metrics file under artifacts/ and a list of assertions against fields in that file. The harness in test_phase_gates.py loads each entry, walks the dotted `path`, applies `op` against `value`, and fails if the live artifact disagrees. If the artifact file is missing entirely (fresh clone), the case is SKIPPED — fresh clones must still produce a green test run.

8c_of_jepa.claim: OF-JEPA v0 on MOVi-A: identity switch rate ~0.002, ~300x better than slot_delta baseline. Joint (mse, switch) gate passed (STATUS.md, PHASE_8C_JEPA_DECISION.md).

assertions.label: OF-JEPA v0 switch_rate >= 100x lower than slot_delta
OF-JEPA v0 visible_position_mse stays sub-1e-4 (content not broken)

18l_geometry_adapter.claim: Phase 18l (single-seed): G1 STRONG gate (adapter recovers geo with mean Spearman >= 0.50) FAILED. Verdict: G1 fail — slots do NOT contain goal-relative geometry. Multi-seed (18mu) later showed an ACCEPTABLE swap; this single-seed record stands as the original strong-gate falsification.

assertions.label: G4 combined_sum_adapter does NOT beat locked by 0.02 (single seed)

18mu_multi_seed.claim: Phase 18mu (6 seeds): supervised geometry within 5pct of geo-VH, acceptable swap, adapter mean Spearman >= 0.45. Verdict: G1+G2+G3(acceptable)+G4 -> ACCEPTABLE SWAP.

assertions.label: G3 acceptable: supervised within 0.02 of locked

18l2_multi_seed.claim: Phase 18l2 multi-seed end-to-end aggregate. Pinned via the artifact's own gates block.
